svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Harness: UNO Q → two ADC carriers → 8 load cells
14 pins on the UNO Q, one wire each. The 5 shared lines chain from the toe carrier to the heel carrier; every ADC has its own chip select.
Cable shields: to the carrier's GND rail only.
